notes:
I found one pick that fits a walk-in visit from August 30 to September 2. I couldn't confirm a second one from an operator's own page.

```json
{
  "picks": [
    {
      "name": "ZOOOM – Children's Innovation Zone, Canada Science and Technology Museum",
      "age_fit": "Designed for children eight and under, with a special area for littles (two and under)",
      "when": "Open 9 a.m. to 5 p.m., Tuesday to Sunday; closed Mondays",
      "source_name": "Canada Science and Technology Museum (Ingenium)"
    }
  ]
}
```

- **What it is:** 
ZOOOM is a self-directed space where kids investigate, experiment, cooperate and play, designed for children eight and under.
 
There is a wind tunnel, a rock wall, and ramps for testing cars you build.

- **Hours:** The museum's plan-your-visit page lists 
Monday closed, and Tuesday through Sunday 9 a.m. to 5 p.m.
 It also says 
the museum is open on statutory holidays, except December 25.
 The page doesn't say which year those hours apply to. The only closure it names is 
September 14 to 18, 2026
, which is after the visit. A Monday in the window would be closed.
- **Price:** I left it out because the fee table I could see was cut off. The page says 
admission is free daily between 4 p.m. and 5 p.m.
 and that 
children aged 2 and under are free.
 The ticket page says 
advance ticketing is strongly recommended.


**Left out:**
- **Canadian Children's Museum:** Its own page only shows hours for 
Sept. 8 to Dec. 9, 2026
, which starts after the visit. I couldn't see hours for your dates. It is also across the river in Gatineau.
- **Canadian Museum of Nature:** I only found third-party listings, and they disagree on hours, so I didn't include it.
- **Zoos, aquariums and playgrounds:** I didn't find an operator page for any of these, so none are included.
